spec_gaps: docs/security-check.md defines a checklist header table (§6) listing 20 domain prefixes (SUP..GOV) but the file body only defines checks for SUP, PKG, and API (31 checks total). §7-§11 referenced by the doc's own text do not exist. Recorded as an Info item for the Human Gatekeeper to close via a §11 amendment. Not authored by either agent role.

Independent reviewer noted a scope/system-description mismatch: §1.1/§2.1 describe a live intercept-validate-autofix-execute pipeline; the actual codebase is predominantly a post-hoc transcript auditor with exactly one live pre-execution control (packages/observe/src proxy guard). This explains why API-004/006/008 map awkwardly onto the real code. Recommend a §11 amendment to the system description rather than treating this as a code defect.

findings.title: One of four original API-003 hits remains open after the iteration-1 fix
findings.evidence: The Engineer Agent's iteration-1 fix closed anthropicDecision.ts, anthropicEscalation.ts, and anthropicFixProposer.ts (now route through configLoader.ts's resolveAnthropicApiKey()) — verified by the independent reviewer: zero process.env reads remain in those three files. observability.ts:45 (process.env.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT) was not in that fix's scope and still reproduces exactly as originally reported. This finding stays open, not fixed, per the independent reviewer's explicit flag: do not let API-003 be marked fully fixed.
findings.remediation: Route the OTLP endpoint default through configLoader.ts the same way the Anthropic API key now is.

findings.title: Denial reason is free-text prose, not an enumerated reason code
findings.evidence: Independent reviewer found a real typed decision: `GuardResult { decision: 'allow'|'block'|'review', reason: string }` with a stable `GuardDecisionKind` enum for `decision`. The `decision` kind is exactly what API-008 wants, but `reason` is free-text prose, not an enumerated reason code — API-008's Pass criterion is 'enumerated reason codes, stable, documented,' which this does not meet for the reason field.
findings.detector: independent-review (new finding, not in iteration-1 pass)
findings.remediation: Add a stable `reasonCode` enum alongside the existing free-text `reason` (keep `reason` for human readability, add the code for programmatic handling).

findings.title: Project cannot be installed with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` — §5.9 gate requirement fails
findings.evidence: Unchanged from iteration 1: no package-lock.json exists (bun.lock only); npm ci --ignore-scripts fails ENOLOCK-class. This is an architectural fact of a bun-only monorepo, not something either fix agent can patch without a scope decision.
findings.remediation: Requires a §11 amendment declaring this project bun-only and replacing every npm-centric Verify command with a bun equivalent, or committing a real package-lock.json and dropping workspace:* everywhere — a human/Gatekeeper decision, not a silent Engineer-Agent tool swap.

findings.title: No vulnerability scan of the production dependency tree has successfully run
findings.evidence: Unchanged from iteration 1: npm audit fails ENOLOCK; no bun-native or osv-scanner substitute has been wired into CI.
findings.remediation: Add `osv-scanner --lockfile=bun.lock` (or bun's native audit once stable) as a CI step.

findings.title: No SBOM is generated in CI
findings.evidence: Unchanged from iteration 1: ci.yml has no SBOM step and no release job.
findings.remediation: Add SBOM generation once a release workflow exists (see PKG-004).

findings.title: No CI publish workflow exists — no provenance attestation is possible
findings.evidence: Unchanged from iteration 1. Independent reviewer notes PKG-005 (2FA/trusted publishing) is dependent on this — fix together.
findings.remediation: Add an OIDC trusted-publishing release workflow; retire the local publish token in .env once live.

findings.title: No long-running operation accepts an AbortSignal — cancellation is unimplemented
findings.evidence: Unchanged from iteration 1: zero AbortSignal usage anywhere in the codebase. Not attempted this iteration (deferred — threading cancellation through the retry chain is a larger change than fit this pass's scope).
findings.remediation: Thread an optional AbortSignal through decision/escalation/fix-proposer call chains; check before each network call and each retry.
